seed: The user, 2026-11-14, with the playhead at 0:00: 'also, the slider covers up the time label'. At Next defaults with no switch touched, a recording opened in View: the play bar's round knob stays inside the scrubber's own room at both ends, resting and hovered (lifted, 1.12 times bigger), so the current time on its left and the length on its right are always whole. Read the -sc pictures: at the start the knob's left edge sits on the bar's left end, clear of the time; at the end its right edge sits on the bar's right end, clear of the length. Then a click on the bar's face an eighth of the way along and seven eighths along puts the knob's centre under the pointer (no jump of half a knob), and In and Out set there are drawn under the knob's centre.

steps.note: the playhead at 0:00 and the pointer away: the knob sits at the left end of the bar, its left edge on the bar's end, the current time beside it whole
the pointer on the bar: the bar thickens and the knob grows 1.12 times, and still leaves the current time whole
Go to End, the pointer still on the bar: the knob at the right end, grown, and the length beside it whole
the pointer off the bar: the knob back to its resting size at the right end, its right edge on the bar's end

steps.comment: The bar runs from x 286 to 1314 in View at this window size (the move step above logs its frame; it starts at 286 since the speed control beside Go to End became a round button). An eighth of the way along is x 415. With the knob stopping half a knob in from each end, that moment is (129 - 13) / 1002 of 3.6s, 417 ms; the old mapping said 452.

steps.note: a real click on the bar an eighth of the way along its face: the playhead goes to the moment whose knob sits under the pointer, and the knob's centre is under the pointer

steps.comment: I opens the tracks, and in Edit the panel runs the window's full height beside the timeline (next-panel-full-height), so the bar is now x 286 to 1085 at y 696. Seven eighths along is x 982.6: (696.6 - 13) / 773 of 3.6s, 3184 ms.

steps.note: a real click seven eighths along: the knob's centre is under the pointer
In and Out set at the two clicks, the playhead parked mid-way: each green mark sits where the knob's centre was when it was set
